title_en: Chen Ruguo v. Taizhou Tianyuan Chemical Co., Ltd. — dispute over water pollution liability
ruling_gist_en: 1. With respect to causation in environmental pollution damage, the claimant need only prove the possibility of pollution by the respondent; the burden of proving the absence of a causal relationship shall be borne by the respondent.
keywords_en: Civil; Water pollution liability dispute; First instance; Basic People's Court; Jiangsu Province; Natural person; Legal person; Tort Liability Law; Burden of proof for causation in environmental pollution; Standard for calculating aquaculture losses; Partially upheld; Water pollution; Fish pond aquaculture; Cyanide discharge; Appraisal of fishery losses; Reversal of burden of proof; Water pollution liability dispute involving an industrial company limited
full_text_en:
Chen Ruguo v. Taizhou Tianyuan Chemical Co., Ltd. — dispute over liability for water pollution

Ruling Summary

1. Regarding the causal link in environmental pollution damage, the claimant need only prove the possibility by the respondent of causing pollution; the burden of proving the absence of a causal link falls on the respondent.

2. After the loss of aquaculture products, the economic loss may be determined based on the actual aquaculture status and conditions, with reference to the compensation standards for the occupation of state-owned fishery waters due to engineering construction as stipulated in local administrative regulations.

Plaintiff: Chen Ruguo, male, 47 years old, of Han nationality, residing in Taizhou Medical High-tech Industrial Development Zone, Jiangsu Province.

Defendant: Taizhou Tianyuan Chemical Co., Ltd., domiciled at Yexu Industrial Park, Yexu Town, Taizhou Medical High-tech Industrial Development Zone, Jiangsu Province.

Plaintiff Chen Ruguo filed a lawsuit with the People's Court of Taizhou Medical High-tech Industrial Development Zone, Jiangsu Province, against defendant Taizhou Tianyuan Chemical Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Tianyuan Company) regarding a dispute over liability for water pollution.

Plaintiff Chen Ruguo alleged: The plaintiff contracted the water surface on the west side of defendant Tianyuan Company for aquaculture. On the morning of April 21, 2012, while inspecting, the plaintiff saw fish jumping, and later all died, and he discovered that Tianyuan Company had a drainage outlet leading to the fish pond and was discharging pollutants. On the morning of April 23, 2012, the Environmental Monitoring Center Station of Taizhou Environmental Protection Bureau and the Taizhou Fishery Administration and Fishing Port Supervisory Station took water samples from the fish pond for testing, and on April 28, 2012, issued a test report showing that the cyanide concentration in the fish pond water reached 0.038 mg/L, and in the wastewater at the discharge outlet reached 1.28 mg/L, exceeding the national Fishery Water Quality Standard by 7.6 times and 256 times, respectively. Cyanide is a highly toxic substance strictly controlled by the state, and among surrounding enterprises, only Tianyuan Company uses cyanide in its production process. Because Tianyuan Company discharged cyanide used in its production process through the drainage outlet into the fish pond contracted by the plaintiff, causing the cyanide content in the fish pond water to exceed the national standard, all fish in the pond died. The plaintiff requests the court to order, according to law, Tianyuan Company to compensate the plaintiff for economic losses of RMB 167,775 (including: loss of stocked fish at RMB 64,425, fish salvage costs at RMB 1,200, fish pond cleaning costs at RMB 36,300, contract fee loss at RMB 1,950, lost profit at RMB 60,000, transportation expenses at RMB 500, appraisal fees at RMB 2,300, and assessment fees at RMB 1,100).

Defendant Tianyuan Company defended: 1. The plaintiff Chen Ruguo possesses an appraisal report on the cause of fish death, but he refuses to provide it; 2. The conclusions in the appraisal report prove that the cause of fish death in this case was that Chen Ruguo did not know how to scientifically raise fish; 3. The fish pond contracted by Chen Ruguo is also unsuitable for aquaculture, and the cyanide in the water meets the national Class II water standard. The fishery water quality standard should not be applied in this case. Chen Ruguo has not proven that the fish pond water was ever improved to meet the fishery water quality standard, so the water quality should not be measured against the standard for fishery water use. The defendant requests that Chen Ruguo's claims be dismissed.

The People's Court of Taizhou Medical High-tech Industrial Development Zone, Jiangsu Province, found the following facts at first instance:

On January 1, 2010, Plaintiff Chen Ruguo and Group 14 of Yexu Town Chengzhong Neighborhood Committee signed an Agreement, stipulating that Chen Ruguo would contract a fish pond located in the area from "Zhou Jiasong in the west to Chen Huichang's house in the east" under Group 14, approximately 4.5 mu, with an annual contract fee of RMB 650, and a contract term of seven years from January 1, 2010, to December 31, 2016. The contract fees for 2011 to 2013, totaling RMB 1,950, had been deducted from Chen Ruguo's collective dividends. On April 21, 2012, fish in the fish pond contracted by Chen Ruguo began to die. Later, according to Chen Ruguo's statement, after all the fish in the pond died, he buried the dead fish, and the defendant Tianyuan Company did not object. On April 23, 2012, the Taizhou Environmental Monitoring Center Station sampled and monitored the water in the fish pond and the wastewater at the discharge outlet. The cyanide content in the fish pond water was 0.0038 mg/L, and the cyanide content in the wastewater at the discharge outlet was 1.28 mg/L. No organophosphorus pesticides were detected in either water body.

On July 18, 2012, Chen Ruguo filed a lawsuit against Tianyuan Company, Taizhou Hongtai Adhesive Co., Ltd., and Taizhou Hongtai Technology Electronics Co., Ltd. in the Hailing District People's Court of Taizhou, seeking compensation of RMB 109,056 from the three defendants. During the trial in the Hailing District People's Court of Taizhou, upon the application of both parties, the Hailing District People's Court of Taizhou commissioned the Jiangdu District Fishery Environmental Monitoring Station of Yangzhou (Grade C-3204 for fishery pollution accident investigation and identification) to appraise and assess the cause of fish death and fishery losses. On October 28, 2012, the Jiangdu District Fishery Environmental Monitoring Station issued the Fishery Pollution Accident Identification Report (Jiangdu Yu Jian [2012] No. 002), which concluded that the aquaculture water area of the fish pond in question is the Taizhuang River, and under the scouring effect of rainfall, it was possible that pond sediment became suspended, causing the water quality to be "slightly turbid"; cyanide was below the standard of ≤0.05 mg/L for Class II water in the Environmental Quality Standards for Surface Water (GB3838-2002) but did not meet the standard of ≤0.005 mg/L for cyanide in the Fishery Water Quality Standard (GB11607-89), and it was more likely that the introduction of exogenous pollutants led to fish death. On December 6, 2012, the Jiangdu District Fishery Environmental Monitoring Station issued the Fishery Pollution Accident Assessment Report (Jiangdu Yu Huan Ping [2012] No. 03), which concluded that: in 2011, in addition to ordinary fish such as silver carp, Chen Ruguo intentionally stocked aggressive fish such as yellowcheek carp, snakehead, and white fish, resulting in low survival rates of ordinary fish; the stocking density of crucian carp and common carp in 2011 was relatively high; the environmental conditions and technical level of Chen Ruguo's pond did not meet the requirements for cultivating yellow catfish, and no yellow catfish were found in the photos of dead fish; in summary, the environmental conditions of Chen Ruguo's aquaculture pond were poor, the stocking was unscientific, and the aquaculture technical level was low. Because the dead fish had already been buried, with reference to the Interim Measures of the People's Government of Jiangsu Province on Compensation for Occupation of State-owned Fishery Waters Due to Engineering Construction and the Base Numbers and Grade Coefficients of Compensation Standards for Occupation of State-owned Fishery Waters in Jiangsu Province (Trial), the compensation standard for net enclosure aquaculture was adopted at RMB 1,500 per mu, combined with the compensation grade coefficient of 1.4 for the Taizhou area, yielding Chen Ruguo's loss at RMB 9,450, partial pollution cleanup costs at RMB 1,050 (i.e., labor costs for removing dead fish; actual pond cleaning costs had not yet been incurred), and the inspection department's evidence collection and assessment fees at RMB 1,050 (actual invoice amount was RMB 1,100). Later, Chen Ruguo withdrew the lawsuit in the Hailing District People's Court of Taizhou.

It was further found that Defendant Tianyuan Company is a company licensed to manufacture and sell ethyl 2,3-dicyanopropionate, and is the only entity in Yexu Industrial Park, Yexu Town, Taizhou Medical High-tech Industrial Development Zone, Jiangsu Province, that uses cyanide. Its factory is located east of the fish pond in question, and its drainage outlet is connected to the drainage outlet leading to the fish pond. From 8:00 p.m. on April 20, 2012, to 8:00 a.m. on April 21, 2012, the precipitation in the Yexu area of Taizhou was 10.5 mm, reaching moderate to heavy rain in 12 hours.

The People's Court of Taizhou Medical High-tech Industrial Development Zone, Jiangsu Province, reasoned at first instance:

A person who causes damage by polluting the environment shall bear tort liability. The Tort Law of the PRC provides that, in a dispute arising from environmental pollution, the polluter shall bear the burden of proof for the circumstances of non-liability or diminished liability as provided by law, and for the absence of a causal link between its conduct and the damage. The evidence submitted by Plaintiff Chen Ruguo and the relevant appraisal reports show that Defendant Tianyuan Company is adjacent to the fish pond contracted by Chen Ruguo, their drainage outlets are connected, and it is the only entity in Yexu Industrial Park that uses cyanide. The moderate to heavy rain from April 20 to the next day caused wastewater containing cyanide to be discharged into the fish pond contracted by the plaintiff, making it more likely that the fish were contaminated and died. In this case, the plaintiff has proven that Tianyuan Company is the exclusive user of cyanide around the fish pond and that there is a connected pipeline for rainwater discharge and the possibility of cyanide leakage. From the fact that the cyanide concentration at the discharge outlet is higher than that in the fish pond water, it can be inferred that there is a greater likelihood that the introduction of exogenous pollutants caused fish death. Tianyuan Company questioned the applicable water quality standard for fishery water use. The national water quality standards are the basis for environmental protection and water conservancy departments to monitor and manage water bodies, and are not a prerequisite or boundary for determining whether a discharging entity bears compensation liability. Therefore, whether the cyanide content in the fish pond water in this case meets the Class II water quality standard and whether it should be measured by the fishery water standard have no necessary relationship with the discharging entity's liability for compensation. Tianyuan Company's defense is insufficient to negate the existence of a causal link in this case. In summary, it can be determined that there is a greater likelihood of a causal link between the polluting conduct and the damage in this case, and Tianyuan Company has failed to prove the existence of grounds for exemption or that there is no causal link between its conduct and the damage, so it shall bear liability for compensation for environmental pollution damage.

Regarding the various losses claimed by Plaintiff Chen Ruguo due to the pollution of the fish pond water, the court determines as follows: 1. Losses caused by fish death. After the fish died, Chen Ruguo failed to take necessary measures promptly to weigh and measure the dead fish but instead buried them, making it impossible to calculate the loss of dead fish. Although the plaintiff submitted evidence on the purchase of fingerlings, due to the poor aquaculture conditions and low aquaculture technical level, the said evidence cannot prove the fish losses caused by water pollution. The appraiser, the Jiangdu District Fishery Environmental Monitoring Station of Yangzhou, based on Chen Ruguo's actual aquaculture status and conditions and in accordance with relevant regulations, determined the economic loss at RMB 9,450 by referring to the compensation standard for occupation of inland aquaculture waters, which is consistent with the actual circumstances of this case. In the absence of sufficient and valid evidence submitted by Chen Ruguo to prove his losses, using this as the basis for determining his losses is fair and reasonable. 2. Regarding the costs of salvaging dead fish, after the fish died in the pond, there were indeed labor costs for salvaging the dead fish (as yet unpaid). Taking into account the appraiser's opinion in the loss assessment, the cost of salvaging dead fish is confirmed at RMB 1,050. 3. Regarding the cost of cleaning the fish pond, the two quotations submitted by Chen Ruguo were not issued by a qualified appraisal or assessment institution, and such costs have not yet been actually incurred. The plaintiff may claim reasonable losses after actual cleaning. 4. Regarding the contract fee loss and lost profit claimed by Chen Ruguo, after the pollution incident occurred, the environmental protection and fishery departments had already arrived at the scene to collect water samples. The accident identification report and accident assessment report issued by the Jiangdu District Fishery Environmental Monitoring Station of Yangzhou, commissioned by both parties, had a cut-off date of December 6, 2012. Thereafter, Chen Ruguo should have promptly cleaned up and continued fishery aquaculture; his delay in restoring aquaculture constitutes a unilaterally expanded loss, and the expected profit he claims is an estimated loss lacking factual basis, so it is difficult to support his claim for expected profit loss. The contract fee should be included in the plaintiff's aquaculture costs and is not supported. 5. Regarding transportation expenses, appraisal fees, and assessment fees, Chen Ruguo claims transportation expenses of RMB 500. Although he did not submit transportation receipts, transportation expenses were indeed incurred after the incident, and this claim is supported in the court's discretion. The appraisal and assessment fees of RMB 3,400 were incurred to ascertain the cause of fish death and losses, are losses caused by the pollution, and are supported by corresponding receipts. In summary, based on Chen Ruguo's existing evidence and the actual circumstances of this case, the total loss caused by the pollution of his contracted fish pond is determined to be RMB 14,400.

Accordingly, the People's Court of Taizhou Medical High-tech Industrial Development Zone, Jiangsu Province, rendered its judgment on June 4, 2014, pursuant to Article 65 and Article 66 of the Tort Law of the PRC, and Article 64, paragraph 1, of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC:

1. Defendant Taizhou Tianyuan Chemical Co., Ltd. shall compensate Plaintiff Chen Ruguo RMB 14,400 within ten days after this judgment takes effect;

2. All other claims of Plaintiff Chen Ruguo are dismissed.

After the first-instance judgment was announced, neither party appealed, and the judgment has become legally effective.
